message: a macro parameter used as a binder was given something that is not a variable
notes: a `let`, `lambda` or pattern binder is a NAME, so a parameter standing in one can only be given a name - this is the same rule `set` targets follow (AX3022)
help: pass a variable name for this parameter, or rewrite the template so the parameter is not a binder
